summary: Candidate addresses a distinct and specific constraint: preventing conflicting next hop configurations when multiple IPs target the same NVA while public/0.0.0.0/0 routes exist. This is orthogonal to peer candidates which cover prefix specificity (531cf59a), hub router IP validation (27ac5968), and branch routing consistency (71bfd5c8). The constraint is well-defined, supported by documentation, and represents a unique safety rule for virtual network connection routing.
